name: com.clunkyard/clunkyard
title: Clunkyard
description: Build, test and publish robots for the Clunkyard programming arena.

tools.name: docs
tools.description: Read Clunkyard's documentation as Markdown: the manual, the rules sheet, each language's API reference (every function's exact name, signature and meaning), the DSL references, the drones guide with its kit drones, and the MCP and local CLI guides. Without a page, lists them all. Also "game" (languages, classes and season as JSON), "rules-data" (every rule value) and "rules-changes". Long pages come in parts.

page.description: A page from the list, such as manual, rules, c, rust, zig, python, vane, drones, player-kit or mcp

since.description: rules-changes only: a snapshot version or name to compare with

tools.name: robots
tools.description: Your robots and the ones you can play against. Without robotId: yours (with recent jobs); among "arena", every robot you can put in a practice match, house robots with their tier (entry, middle, top) and a hint; among "deleted", the robots you deleted, restorable for 30 days. With robotId: view "project" (default) gives its saved revision, its draft (uncommitted changes), files and staging; "draft" gives the draft alone: its base, the robot's latest revision, whether it is behind, its changes and conflicts, and what the latest revision changed since the base; "file" reads a file of the draft (revisionId for a saved revision), whole or by startLine and endLine, with its sha256 and size; "search" finds a pattern in the draft's files, line by line; "revisions" lists saved revisions; "build" gives its latest build (or jobId's) with diagnostics, and with offset a page of the log.

path.description: view file: the file; view search: a file or directory to search

revisionId.description: view file: a saved revision instead of the draft

pattern.description: view search: the text to find

regex.description: view search: pattern is a regular expression

context.description: view search: lines around each match

tier.description: among arena: only house robots of this tier

limit.description: Rows a page holds at most (default 50); fewer when rows would pass the size limit

tools.name: matches
tools.description: Matches and what happened in them. With matchId: view "summary" (default) gives the state, each robot's revision, placement and combat summary, and the replay; "events" every event and your robots' debug.log lines and drone reports with a few sampled states; "ticks" robot states turn by turn, with the health each lost by cause, and your robots' requests, what the referee accepted and what they sensed (fromTick, toTick, every; pages by nextFromTick); "decisions" your strategist robots' recorded decisions. Without matchId, a list newest first: scope "mine" (default; the matches you queued, by state), "played" (every match one of your robots played, with its record by game and revision on the first page), "public" (recent public matches), "replays" (public replays) or "latest" (each of your robots' latest replay). Replays are kept 30 days.

statsFor.description: view summary: a robot whose full statistics to add

every.description: view ticks: sample every nth tick (default 1); events and log lines are never skipped

revision.description: scope played: only this revision ordinal

opponent.description: Only matches this robot also played

rated.description: false for practice and other unrated matches

limit.description: Rows a page holds at most (default 20); fewer when rows would pass the size limit

tools.name: standings
tools.description: Ratings and tournaments. view "pools" (default) lists the season's ranking pools; "leaderboard" the ratings in one pool (with history for rating history); "tournaments" upcoming, running and recent tournaments and your entries; "tournament" one tournament's schedule and entries.

limit.description: Rows a page holds at most (default 50); fewer when rows would pass the size limit

tools.name: create_robot
tools.description: Create a robot from a language's starter. Returns the robot, its first revision and files, and its language's API reference: read it before writing code, and use only the functions it lists.

language.description: A language from docs, such as c, rust, zig, python or vane

slug.description: URL name; made from the name when left out

operationId.description: Identifies this operation for retries. Leave it out for a fresh one; pass the one a pending result gave to finish it.

tools.name: build_robot
tools.description: Edit a robot's draft, its uncommitted changes on the server, build it on the hosted builder and wait for the result, like a language server: passed, or failed with the compiler's diagnostics (file, line, column, severity, message) and the end of its log. Edits stay in the draft (nothing is committed) until commit: give each change as edits (exact text), lines (line ranges), content (a whole new or small file), delete, renameTo or revert; several files in one call apply together or not at all, and the result shows only the regions that changed. Without changes it builds the draft as it stands. commit "message" makes the draft one revision (and builds that); discard true resets it to the latest revision. If the robot changed since the draft began (a push or another commit), the commit is refused: rebase true merges the draft onto the robot's latest revision, marking conflicts with <<<<<<< draft and >>>>>>> head; write each conflicted file, or resolve it with take mine or theirs, build again and commit. Still building when the wait ends: call again with the jobId it returns. build false only edits.

edits.description: Exact replacements, each oldText occurring once in the file

lines.description: Line ranges replaced (1-based, inclusive; end = start - 1 inserts; empty text deletes), all against the file as it is

content.description: The whole file: for a new or small file

renameTo.description: Move the file, with any edits

diff.description: A unified diff of this file, applied without fuzz

baseHash.description: Refuse if the file is no longer this sha256

commit.description: A commit message: make the draft one revision

rebase.description: Merge the draft onto the robot's latest revision, when a push or another commit moved it

resolve.description: Settle files a rebase left in conflict: mine keeps the draft's side, theirs the latest revision's

expectedVersion.description: The draft version your edit is based on: the workingCopyVersion of your last file read, or version from your last build_robot result. Required for edits, lines and diff unless each such change has baseHash; refuses the edit if another writer moved the draft

revisionId.description: Build this saved revision instead of the draft

operationId.description: Identifies this operation for retries. Leave it out for a fresh one; pass the one a pending result gave to finish it.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 40, at most 55; 0 returns at once)

tools.name: update_robot
tools.description: Change your robot's name, its publication (visibility "published" makes its source public; needs publish) or its availability for rated competition (needs compete); or delete it (restorable for 30 days, then purged), restore a deleted robot, or purge one now. Ask the player first before publishing, changing availability, deleting or purging.

purge.description: Remove a deleted robot now, for good

tools.name: stage_robot
tools.description: Test a change without resetting the competing rating. hold keeps the revision that competes while later saves become a testing revision that plays only in practice; promote makes the tested revision (pass revisionId) compete, from a fresh rating; release ends the hold, so the latest save competes; discard saves the competing source back as the latest. Ask the player first. robots with view "project" shows the staging state.

revisionId.description: promote or discard: the revision you tested

operationId.description: Identifies this operation for retries. Leave it out for a fresh one; pass the one a pending result gave to finish it.

tools.name: practice_match
tools.description: Play unrated hosted practice matches and wait for the outcome: each robot's result, placement, how the match ended, damage dealt and taken, its last status, and where to read the match turn by turn. robots lists yours (they play their draft, uncommitted changes included, as a private draft revision; list a held robot in competing to seat its competing revision); opponents takes robot IDs or a house tier, "entry", "middle" or "top", which picks a house robot of that tier. mode and ruleset default to 2d classic and resourceMode to the first class every robot plays (standard, reflex, then open); games and count queue a batch. Still playing when the wait ends: call again with the matchIds it returns. If a call is interrupted, check matches with scope "mine" before queueing again.

opponents.description: Robot IDs, or entry, middle or top

games.description: Games to queue; replaces mode and ruleset

seed.description: One match only, or one per game

objective.description: Add king of the hill or pickups (default none)

drones.description: Let robots whose bot.json names a drone program launch it (default off; docs page "drones")

working.description: false plays your robots' saved revisions instead of their working copies

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 40, at most 55; 0 returns at once)

tools.name: tournament_entry
tools.description: Enter one of your robots in a tournament, or withdraw it. Ask the player first. standings with view "tournaments" lists them.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the people who run Clunkyard what is confusing, broken or could be better: these tools, robots, the rules, the docs, the site, or an idea. Use it whenever you notice something as you work. They read it daily; it gets no reply and changes nothing in the game. Plain text; never include secrets, keys or personal data.

message.description: What happened or what would help

category.description: mcp for these tools, robots, game for the rules and play, docs, site, bug, idea or other
